*An R package providing core data structures for movement data*

The primary aim of the _anicore_ package is to provide S3 classes and methods for representing and manipulating movement data.

## Installation

You can install the development version of *anicore* with:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
install.packages('anicore', repos = c('https://animovement.r-universe.dev', 'https://cloud.r-project.org'))
```

Once you have installed the package, you can load it with:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library("anicore")
```


## Citation {#citation}

If you enjoy the package, please make sure to cite it. If you find a bug, feel free to open an issue. 

To cite *anicore* in publications use:

```{r}
citation("anicore")
```
